name: Horse Racing Hairpin

distinct_build_audit.interpretation: Six reusable distinct components across pages48-53. Grandstand steps are one assembly. No invented complete landscape circuit; raised/lowered gate is one stateful build.

origin.description: Northwest bottom corner of template; road exits along south edge, separated by center grass notch. x east/right, y up, z south/back; zero schematic offset.

coordinate_convention: layers[y][z][x]; all cells explicit, including air; x fastest

dimension_audit.confidence: Printed footprint exact; tile thickness and contour pixels inferred.

material_audit.source: p49 road concrete; p51 colored template renders
material_audit.labels: gray/white concrete explicitly on p49; red-white curbs, pale shoulder and grass visible on p51
material_audit.implemented: gray_concrete,white_concrete,red_concrete,gravel,grass_block,dirt. Gravel shoulder identification is visual, not a printed material list.

state_audit.surface: All full cubes; grass snowy=false. No slabs,mechanisms,doors,fluids or entities.

occlusion_uncertainties: Oblique photographs do not determine every voxel. Printed callouts are prioritized; unprinted silhouettes, hidden supports and pixel patterns are inferred, not certified exact.
No fluids, entities or complex block-entity NBT. No live-world, redstone-timing, gravity-update or placement tests.

The large landscape circuits on pages51 and53 are explicitly customizable examples, not a dimensioned seventh build. Trees, river, horses and riders are not included. Start-line direction/powered vignettes are states/views of one mechanism, not duplicate builds.
Rounded outer curb is inferred as a symmetric stepped half-ellipse. Exact checker phase, shoulder texture and small inside grass notch are not dimensioned.
This is the standalone hairpin tile on p51, not the complete landscaped course.
